column7: A WebAuthn login/finish post-verdict GetUserRoles error left an MFAStepUpGrant and a login audit event behind while reporting failure. The identity is now resolved before anything is minted (#2841). Same test as webauthn-login-partial-stepup-grant-001 (tracked there under #2841); the login-attempt slot kept after a post-verdict fault is the decided behaviour of #2880. Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
